LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling, word order)
Topic 3.7: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling, word order) in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write sentences correctly? 2. What is the importance of journaling in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. play a vocabulary charades game on parts of the body (e.g. 脸 liǎn、牙 yá、 手 shǒu、头发 tóufa etc.) as their peers guess and list down the identified word,

2. work jointly to circle words and phrases related to grooming items in a word square/ word search (e.g. 水 Shuǐ、梳子 Shūzi、牙膏 Yágāo、牙 刷 Yáshuā、剪刀 Jiǎndāo etc.),

3. look at word cards on different personal grooming activities and match them to their respective grooming items with peers (e.g. 刷牙 shuā yá、洗脸 xǐ liǎn、洗手 xǐ shǒu、洗澡 xǐzǎo、梳头发 shū tóufà、 编头发 biān tóufà、剪头发 jiǎn tóufà etc.),

4. write down simple sentences on the uses of the various self-grooming 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. play a vocabulary charades game on parts of the body (e.g. 脸 liǎn、牙 yá、 手 shǒu、头发 tóufa etc.) as their peers guess and list down the identified word,
2. work jointly to circle words and phrases related to grooming items in a word square/ word search (e.g. 水 Shuǐ、梳子 Shūzi、牙膏 Yágāo、牙 刷 Yáshuā、剪刀 Jiǎndāo etc.),
3. look at word cards on different personal grooming activities and match them to their respective grooming items with peers (e.g. 刷牙 shuā yá、洗脸 xǐ liǎn、洗手 xǐ shǒu、洗澡 xǐzǎo、梳头发 shū tóufà、 编头发 biān tóufà、剪头发 jiǎn tóufà etc.),
4. write down simple sentences on the uses of the various self-grooming 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: Self-awareness skills are developed as the learner writes down why they need to practise personal grooming.

Values:
Love: The learner portrays a caring attitude towards their bodies when they list down the importance of personal grooming.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Personal hygiene: The learner exhibits a commitment to caring for their own body and overall well-being as they keep a journal

on their grooming routine.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Agriculture and Nutrition on the concept of how personal hygiene affects one’s overall body

wellness.
